title.en: we belong here: odesza on the riverfront.
title.de: we belong here: odesza am riverfront.

line.en: the debut of we belong here, a dance festival on the riverfront next to the french quarter. odesza opens friday with a dj set; the day runs from 2pm to 10pm.
line.de: das debüt von we belong here, einem tanzfestival am riverfront direkt neben dem french quarter. odesza eröffnet den freitag mit einem dj-set; der tag läuft von 14 bis 22 uhr.
line.tr: we belong here'ın ilk yılı, french quarter'ın yanında riverfront'ta bir dans festivali. odesza cuma günü dj seti ile açıyor; gün 14:00'den 22:00'ye sürüyor.

sparks.why: We Belong Here New Orleans, 13-15 nov 2026, Goldring Woldenberg Riverfront Park; ODESZA Dj set on friday (festival listings at technoairlines.com and thatfestivalsite.com); daily 2pm-10pm from discotech.me. Age policy conflicts between listings (18+ vs 21+), so check webelonghere.world/neworleans.
